text:
anya: Hey team — launching next Wed + webinar the following week. Need a compact benchmark visual kit (hero diagram, 3 microtiles, one-pager template) + inbound lead routing diagram for the marketing site. Goal: show latency vs cost tradeoffs and routing rules for hosted/dedicated/private. Deadline: first comps by Tue EOD. :rocket:

matt: Got it. Can you drop the data and a Figma starter file? Also confirm sizes (banner / social / slide). :eyes:

anya: Figma link: https://figma.com/redwood/launch-bench-starter (placeholder). Data CSV: https://files.redwood/test/bench-data.csv. Sizes: hero 1200x628, slide 1920x1080, social square 1080x1080, microtile 600x400. Mobile-first layout required.

kai: For inbound routing, we want tags on form submit: tier=d, model=redwood-small, intent=webinar. Mapping here:```form_field,tag
utm_source,source
plan_choice,tier
interest_area,topic
```Will we have separate routes for enterprise leads?

anya: Yes — enterprise -> sales-assigned queue, otherwise marketing nurture. Include a simple branching diagram and CSV mapping for downstream webhook.

sophia: Brand notes: use Primary Blue for latency traces (#0A6AFF), Accent Coral for cost (#FF6B61). Use Open Sans Mid for headers and Inter for body. Provide white and dark logo variants; maintain 24px clearspace. Also run AA contrast checks on the microtiles. :white_check_mark:

matt: Cool. For the hero diagram: do you want latency on x or y? And should cost be a sparkline inset or full axis?

anya: Put latency on x, cost on y. Add a small inset sparkline showing per-token cost variance. Add callouts for "smart routing" (canary/fallback) and "cache/batching" wins. Keep copy tight — 6 words max for main headline.

matt: Copy options for CTAs? short list pls.

anya: CTA A: "Try Hosted API — Free Credits"
CTA B: "Book a Dedicated Demo"
CTA C: "Download benchmark one-pager"

matt: Good. I'll mock 2 hero variants (A/B headline + CTA) and the microtiles set. Will tag layers for dev export. Deliverables by Tue EOD as PNGs + export-ready Figma. :sparkles:

design-bot: New ticket created: DESIGN-4823 "Launch benchmark kit & inbound routing diagram" — assignee: matt, due: 1766073600.

sophia: Quick legal: include small-tradesmark footer and note if we mention third-party model names. Send legal a draft for review once comps are up. Also request alt copy for each image.

matt: Motion ask? Is subtle parallax allowed for hero hero only? budget?

anya: Small motion okay (subtle parallax + sparkline draw). No >10s animations, keep file weight low. Budget approved.

kai: I'll attach the webhook spec in the ticket and set up a short demo for the webinar lead flow next week.

matt: Ok locking on specs. Will ping when first comps are ready. Thanks. :thumbsup:

anya: Thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround. If anything blocks, ping me in thread or DM. :pray:
